rationale: Comparison for unit:given.syntax against lean:Unique/Syntax:VariableId, lean:Unique/Syntax:Place, lean:Unique/Syntax:Value, lean:Unique/Syntax:Statement. Place has variable/field constructors; Value has only give/new, with recursive argument lists; Statement contains a destination and value. These match the grammars and distinguish place syntax from value production. Freshness is an operational condition, not encoded in String variable names. limitations: Author self-review, not an independent fresh reviewer.

Lean checks proof correctness separately. Tooling review checks implementation and finite test coverage, not universal correctness or browser/CDN behavior. Additional context keys identify supporting definitions inspected in those files, not an audit of every proof or line.
